stories.title: LSU asks judge to throw out 'unwarranted' lawsuit by SEC
stories.summary: LSU is asking a federal judge to dismiss the SEC's lawsuit against the Tigers, arguing that many of the plaintiffs in the case are protected by sovereign immunity as state officials and the league doesn't have jurisdiction.

stories.title: Broncos' Payton: RB Dobbins suspended one game for detrimental conduct
stories.summary: The Broncos suspended running back J.K. Dobbins for one game for conduct detrimental to the team.

stories.title: Aiyuk scheduled for visit Wednesday with Commanders, agent says
stories.summary: Wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk is scheduled to visit Wednesday with the Commanders, agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: 'A big part of what we do': Johnson to stick with Swift's role in Bears' run game
stories.summary: Chicago Bears running back D'Andre Swift won't have an extended stay in Ben Johnson's doghouse after fumbling in the fourth quarter against the Saints.

stories.title: 'Shocked' Alberts told he won't be AD after Michigan flip; owed $17.2M, lawyers say
stories.summary: Trev Alberts was "shocked and disheartened" to be informed by the search firm representing Michigan that he will not be the Wolverines' next AD, he told ESPN.
